6.note: 4QDeut^j reads בני אלהים (sons of God/divine beings) where MT has בני ישראל (sons of Israel). LXX ὑιοὶ θεοῦ corroborates the DSS reading. DJD XIV. This is one of the most theologically significant Torah variants.

0.note: 4QDeut^q preserves a longer text including 'Rejoice, O heavens, with him; bow down to him, all you gods!' — absent from MT but supported by LXX. DJD XIV.
